scope: SubKNet and MPHGNN mechanisms relevant to miRNA-drug resistance association prediction; not a systematic review

sources.title: Subgraph-Aware Graph Kernel Neural Network for Link Prediction in Biological Networks
sources.authors: Menglu Li, Zhiwei Wang, L. Liu, Xuan Liu, Wen Zhang
sources.venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
sources.read_depth: Abstract and highlight (search result); official code cloned and read (code/model.py, code/subgraph_extraction.py). Reported miRNA-drug performance taken from MPHGNN Table 1.
sources.mechanism: Per-link h-hop enclosing subgraph (double-radius node labels) fed to a trainable graph-kernel neural network that decomposes each subgraph into trainable graph filters with diversity regularization; node embeddings from the global network are added as auxiliary information.

sources.title: MPHGNN: metapath-guided heterogeneous graph neural network for miRNA-drug resistance association prediction
sources.authors: Guangsheng Huang, Yali Peng, Shuai Wu, Hang Wei, Shigang Liu
sources.read_depth: Full text read from PMC (abstract, methods, results, ablation, parameter analysis).
sources.mechanism: miRNA-gene-drug heterogeneous network with miRNA expression, ChemBERTa drug structure and HumanNet gene-gene functional links; gene-space GCN similarity feature; metapath <miRNA-gene-gene-drug> with two-direction node aggregation and attention-based metapath embedding projector; global GCN encoder plus MLP edge decoder; metapath-level and global-level scores combined; BCE training.
